description.value: Kinaree Thai Restaurant is a family-run authentic Thai dining room in downtown Courtenay, co-owned by Soulat Ma and head chef Pasthida Ma, whose menu draws on centuries of family cooking traditions. The restaurant takes its name from the Kinaree, a mythical half-woman, half-swan figure from Thai legend, and the interior features a bronze Kinaree statue and traditional Thai art on deep red walls. A touring cyclist looking for a sit-down meal in the Comox Valley would find a well-established local favourite with a broad menu spanning curries, noodle dishes, and seafood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the website at kinaree.ca, which confirms the phone number (250) 898-8639 matching OSM, provides a full address (526A Cumberland Road, Courtenay, BC V9N 2C7) absent from OSM tags, and identifies the business as a sit-down Thai restaurant. The menu lists vegetarian-friendly items including Pad Mix Vegetables and Pad Tofu Curry, supporting a vegetarian claim. No bike infrastructure, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, or takeout are explicitly mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null. A notable name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Kinaree Thai Cuisine' while the website consistently uses 'Kinaree Thai Restaurant'.
